title: Integrations
lead: The services this app works with: your media library, the sources it searches for releases, and your download clients.
unknownType: This version of the app can't connect to “{{type}}”. You can only remove this integration.
actionFailed: Could not change this integration. Reload the page and try again.
refreshFailed: Refresh failed, showing the last loaded integrations.
empty: No integrations yet. Click Add integration to connect Jellyfin, a Torznab source such as Prowlarr, or qBittorrent.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.message: The app forgets {{name}}, its stored credentials and its path mappings. Nothing changes in the service itself. This can't be undone.

dialog.createDescription: Connect a service. You can test the connection before you save it.
dialog.editDescription: Credentials are stored encrypted and never shown again. Leave a field empty to keep what is stored.
dialog.typesFailed: Could not load the services this app can connect to.
dialog.serviceFixed: The service can't be changed. To connect another one, add a new integration.
dialog.name: Name

addressHelp.generic: The address the service answers at, starting with http:// or https://.
addressHelp.jellyfin: Jellyfin's address, with its base path if it has one, such as http://192.168.1.10:8096.
addressHelp.torznab: The feed's Torznab address. Prowlarr shows it in the indexer's details, such as http://192.168.1.10:9696/1/api.
addressHelp.qbittorrent: The address of qBittorrent's Web UI, such as http://192.168.1.10:8080.

dialog.secretStored: Stored. Leave empty to keep it.
dialog.enabledHint: Switched off, the app keeps the settings but leaves the service alone.

mappings.title: Path mappings
mappings.help: If {{service}} sees your media under other paths than this app does, map each of its folders to this app's, for example /downloads → /media.
mappings.none: No mappings: {{service}} sees your media at the same paths as this app.
